summary: See our latest bathroom design featuring our brand new Lust rimless back to wall suite and Form above counter basins!
title: Get The Look 5 - Monthly Bathroom Design Inspiration
bodyHtml:
This month's Get The Look bathroom is a gorgeous light filled refuge, swathed in classic Carrara marble with features of rich royal blue.

Shades of lavish blue is brandished across two feature walls, highlighted with subtle brushed nickel metallics which sit in stark contrast to the whites and marble which are perennial classics

A custom wall hung vanity exhibits two Form Oval above counter basins in tactile matte white. 

Our Pop wall mounted brushed nickel basin mixer adds a touch of metal with our understated Silo Mirrors hung above in unison.

3 wall hung drawer units in muted dark blues provides ample storage to maintain this minimalist bathroom without losing any convenience.

Our brand new Lust rimless back-to-wall suite compliments our Lust Bath, which follows a uniform curved aesthetic that ties in the design elements across the whole bathroom.

A light filled tiled recess sits above the Matte white Lust Bath, serving both as a feature and for functionality.

Find out more about all our products used in this month’s get the look below.
